Start with a single ship and grow to become an interstellar industrial empire as you leave your mark on the galaxy. Join our Community About the Game You are at the frontier of human-charted space in a small mining ship, tasked with expanding humanity's footprint amongst the stars. To succeed, you’ll need to collect resources, automate production, expand your base of operations, and research new technologies. You start out with a single mining ship in a resource-rich asteroid belt. Use your scanners to find the best places to mine, and then refine the resources on your ship. Build a space station to set up a permanent base of operations which you can begin to expand and automate. Onboard your stations, the factories you build are the heart of your industrial operation . Build machines, connect them with conveyor belts, and plan your production lines to keep everything flowing at full efficiency. Once that's running, that same logic extends across systems - automated supply routes between stations , and a fleet that keeps everything provisioned while you focus on expanding your operations. Every ship and station is yours to design, inside and out . Module by module, you decide cargo capacity, reactor placement and weapons - whatever the situation calls for. Save designs to use again, share them with friends, or build freely in creative mode. You'll need those weapons. Your industrial activity has woken something up - an ancient alien defence network that's identified you as a threat . Use your fleet to protect what you've built, or take the fight to them before the next wave arrives. Research new technology with the items you produce. Each unlock opens up new ships, station modules, items and upgrades - everything you need to push further out. You will need to expand your industrial operations into new frontiers, but each new area will bring its own challenges and enemies to overcome. Use all of the tools at your disposal to build the ultimate battleship capable of handling any threat on your path to victory. Venture into the unknown, with each procedurally generated star system offering unique logistic challenges to overcome. Explore wrecks, find new resources, and discover stellar phenomena such as black holes and neutron stars . Play solo, or in co-op where each player is the captain of their own ship . Divide responsibilities however you like - one on logistics, another on defence, another out exploring - or work side by side on the same objective. Co-op opens up what’s possible. The bigger the crew, the bigger the empire. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends. FOLLOW US X: @Infini_Fun About the Game Have you ever dreamed of creating a game masterpiece that defines an era, or moves millions of players? Have you ever imagined standing shoulder-to-shoulder with gaming legends, carving your own name into the annals of gaming history? Welcome to Star of Games, a deeply immersive simulation management game centered around game development. Here, you'll step into the shoes of an ambitious game developer, starting from a small garage studio and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating legends, to creating them, and ultimately changing the world. I. Forge Legendary Games: Start from the Genes In Star of Games, creating games is no longer just about combining genres. We introduce the revolutionary "Game Gene System", allowing you to delve deep into the soul of game design. Deconstruct Legends, Extract Genes : Place iconic titles into your "Gene Decoding Lab." Analyze the core of their success—level design, narrative pacing, game mechanics… everything can be extracted and become the foundation of your own creations. Recombine Genes, Create New Classics : Fuse unique gene sequences and integrate your chosen development philosophy—be it a "player-experience-first" craftsman's approach or a "tech-driven innovation" geek route. Every decision you make will shape the soul of your game. Deep Marketing, Ignite the Buzz : Move beyond simple paid promotions. Build your marketing team and strategize a campaign that engages players, media, and influencers. Will you create mystery, showcase boldly, use scarcity tactics, or rely on word-of-mouth? The market is yours to set ablaze. II. Build a Game Empire: Dance with Legends Personal success is just the beginning—building a great company is the real challenge. In the vast world of Star of Games, you are not alone. Encounter Legends, as Rivals or Allies : Well-known companies will be your inspirations, your competitors, and potential partners. Compete with them for Game of the Year, collaborate to gain tech licenses, or even participate in developing their legendary sequels. R ecruit Masters, Nurture New Talent : As you rise to prominence, legendary producers might appear, offering guidance, tasks, or even a chance to recruit them! At the same time, nurture your employees—they have dreams too, and one day, a star from your company might become your strongest rival. Define Your Path, Evolve Your Tech : Our unique tech tree system represents not just technological advancement, but the evolution of your company's strategy, culture, and business model. Will you become an "Artisan Workshop" focused on refined games, or a "Tech Titan" leading industry trends? The future is shaped by every R&D choice you make. III. Transcend Gaming: Become a Cultural Icon When your works become classics and your company is hailed as legendary, your influence will extend far beyond the gaming industry. You will become a cultural symbol defining the next era. Cross-media Expansion, Build an IP Empire : Lead the film and TV adaptation of your legendary titles, collaborating with top directors to create box office hits. License or build physical theme parks based on your game worlds, turning them into pilgrimage sites for fans globally. Elevate Value, Impact Society : Partner with universities and medical institutions to develop serious educational games or therapeutic experiences. Use the power of games to create profound social value and earn respect that goes beyond commerce. Reach the Pinnacle, Achieve Immortality : Establish your own video game museum, found an award named after you, and have your design philosophy written into textbooks. You are no longer just a successful businessperson—you have become a part of gaming culture itself. Game Features Dynamic Story Generator : Every new game is a unique story. The personal dramas of employees, competitors' business secrets, and the birth of legends are all dynamically generated by your choices. Relatability Meets Relaxation : Authentically captures industry challenges like project delays, technical bottlenecks, and team conflicts—enough to make you smile wryly in recognition. The overall lighthearted and humorous tone makes strategizing and decision-making a genuine pleasure. Ultimate Freedom of Exploration : From game concepts to corporate strategy, talent management to business alliances—there is no single formula for success. Every path can lead to your own version of Rome. A Treasure Trove of Easter Eggs : The game is packed with countless Easter eggs referencing gaming history, industry jargon, and classic titles, waiting to be discovered and savored by true core players. input.china_demand: Build and lead a colony on the surface of an endless Wall. Manage resources and your people, develop new technologies, defend against relentless zyrex attacks, and send robo-spiders on risky expeditions. Keep the colony from collapsing – in Wall World, it's easy to fall. The Wall is a colossal structure stretching far beyond the visible horizon, hiding traces of ancient eras and unexplained phenomena within its depths. Here, among stone, metal, and darkness, humanity has been forced to build a new life – clinging to the Wall and trying to survive in a world full of threats and mysteries. Wall World Strategy is a colony sim on a sheer vertical surface, where every decision affects the stability of the system. Build and expand your base, gather resources, take care of your people, strengthen your defenses, and send expeditions into distant regions and unexplored depths. Each new step forward brings not only opportunities for growth but also new dangers. Survival depends on your foresight, your ability to manage limited resources, and your willingness to make difficult decisions. BUILD AND EXPAND THE COLONY Establish a base on the surface of the Endless Wall and gradually turn a small outpost into a large, stable, and well-defended colony. Plan the placement of key structures, develop production chains, expand living areas, and build infrastructure capable of supporting both population growth and stable operations. As your colony grows, you will need to decide how to expand, which structures to prioritize, and where to allocate resources – whether into production, housing, or defense. WITHSTAND THE THREATS The Wall is far from lifeless. In its shadows lurk zyrexes – dangerous creatures that will attack your colony again and again, testing its defenses, organization, and your ability to respond. Strengthen your defenses, secure vulnerable areas, and decide how much you can afford to invest in protection. Additional pressure comes from emergency events such as accidents, disasters, and environmental hazards. They won't destroy your colony instantly, but they will disrupt its operations and trigger cascading problems. MANAGE YOUR SOCIETY Your colony is, above all, made up of people – living, working, hoping for the future, and depending on your decisions. Monitor their condition and take into account how they react to your choices. Overpopulation, food shortages, or supply disruptions can quickly lead to declining efficiency, crisis, and riots. Caring for your people is a core part of the strategy. The state of your population determines the performance of the entire colony – its productivity and its ability to endure prolonged periods of danger. A strong and well-supported society recovers faster from attacks and moves forward with greater confidence. GATHER RESOURCES AND ADVANCE Start with basic resource extraction and gradually build a more complex economy. Explore the depths of the Wall, search for stable resource deposits, and develop the infrastructure needed to use them efficiently. Technological progress allows you to improve core systems and unlock new possibilities. Enhance resource gathering and processing, reduce costs, increase efficiency, and strengthen your colony against external threats. Some technologies accelerate infrastructure development, others improve defense, automate key processes, or expand your ability to explore new areas of the Wall. SEND OUT EXPEDITIONS To explore beyond your colony, deploy robo-spiders – specialized machines designed for scouting, resource extraction, and operations in remote areas. Send them into uncharted sectors of the Wall to expand your reach, gather resources, uncover rare discoveries, and explore areas that are too dangerous or inaccessible for humans. However, distant regions bring not only opportunities but also risks. Expeditions may encounter hostile environments, unstable terrain, unknown lifeforms, or remnants of ancient machinery whose purpose has long been forgotten. Prepare your equipment, assess the risks, and decide how far you're willing to go. EXPLORE THE DEPTHS OF THE WALL The Wall is more than just the surface your colony clings to. Beneath it lies an entire world filled with resources, forgotten technologies, and rare artifacts. Extract valuable materials, recover technological samples that can accelerate your development, and uncover unique objects that help you understand this world. As you explore, you will begin to find answers – but each discovery raises new questions about the nature of the Wall and why it became humanity's last refuge. PLAY BY YOUR OWN RULES Develop your colony in Sandbox Mode without story constraints or time pressure. Choose from different maps and difficulty levels, tailor the conditions to your liking, and keep playing for as long as you want. Zyrexes will still attack, but you can play at your own pace and experiment with different development and defense strategies. Here, clear rulesets, cultural exhibits, and smooth tabletop matches live side by side. There is no required reading before you play—feel free to look around, sit down to a game you grew up with, or read an exhibit label and discover a game from another region. Local rules are the collection this museum treasures most. A growing museum Yandra Studio is building this museum piece by piece. More regional games and rulesets will keep arriving, and each one is placed on display only once it plays smoothly and its story can be told properly.
